authorization: Decided on 24 Sep 2026: evaluate the frozen finalists once on the 29 TEST papers (14 original_test + 15 new_test), with a hard cap of USD 80 on the API bill, and pick the next day by the frozen rule.

budget.estimate_usd: ~52 (Opus ~40, Kimi ~3, Sol ~6) scaled from DEV bills; stop dispatch before the cap

caveats: All DEV numbers for these rows are best-of-many DEV selections and are optimistic; TEST is the first held-out estimate.
Each row is one generation; single-run spread on DEV was about +/-3 matches for Qwen, so differences under ~5 matches are not meaningful.

cohort.recall_denominator: all TEST gold definitions, counted at preparation

eligibility: A row is eligible for the pick only if every paper produced output and at most 5% of its extraction windows / verifier batches failed. Failed windows or batches contribute no records and are counted and reported; missing verifier verdicts reject that candidate. No model-output retries beyond each recipe's historical documented policy.

excluded.reason: Saved configuration records 'Saved signature and demonstrations unavailable' and 'Full historical runtime settings unavailable'; cannot be rerun faithfully.

matcher: frozen M3 one-to-one definition matcher, cutoff 0.50 (src.metric_audit.compare full_only; scripts.score_selected_rerun conventions)
pick_rule: Among eligible rows with TEST recall >= 80%, pick the highest precision, but prefer a self-hosted Qwen row if its recall is within 2 matches of the leader. If no row reaches 80%, pick the highest recall among rows with precision >= 15%. Report every row either way.
